Diagnose a call by UUID. Asks Plivo's AI assistant to pull the SIP / media
trace and explain what happened — answer time, drop cause, codec
negotiation issues, anything anomalous.

Equivalent to:
  plivo ask --call-uuid <call_uuid> "Help me debug this call: <call_uuid>"

…just shorter. Streams the answer as it comes; expect 30–120s for the
full investigation since the debugger does live log lookups.

Usage:
  plivo voice calls diagnose <call_uuid> [flags]

Aliases:
  diagnose, diag

Examples:
  plivo voice calls diagnose 01fe1ff8-fd57-4901-a150-d55b8dfd669b
  plivo voice call diagnose 01fe1ff8-fd57-4901-a150-d55b8dfd669b   # alias
  plivo voice calls diagnose <uuid> -o json                        # JSONL

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for diagnose

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --api-url string     override the REST API base URL (or set PLIVO_API_URL) — for pointing at a non-production gateway
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
